vendored_files.source: unified diff from complete norm.cu to the standalone baseline; helper provenance remains bound by the complete common.cuh and hip.h snapshots

standalone_changes: restricted launch to contiguous one-channel one-sample rows
fixed template specialization to block_size=256, do_multiply=false, do_add=false
replaced ggml launch wrappers and PDL hooks with direct HIP runtime calls
copied only the float SUM helper path and expressed WARP_SIZE as kLogicalWidth
added binary input/output, HIP error reporting, and device identity output
included HIP math declarations and mapped rsqrtf to the same __ocml_rsqrt_f32 entry used by Clang's omitted force-included HIP math wrapper
preserved logical32 XOR shuffle, shared partials, block barrier, second reduction, and broadcast
